q: How do I estimate the carbon footprint of building a flyover?
title: Flyover construction carbon
short: Cement, steel rebar and prestressing strand dominate, so start with quantities from the bill of quantities and supplier factors. Add site diesel for piling rigs, cranes and batching, and divide by length. Report embodied materials separately from construction fuel.

ul: Concrete by grade, or cement and fly ash bought.
Bearings, expansion joints and crash barriers.
Diesel for piling, cranes and generators.
Electricity for batching plants and lighting.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
